facts.text: I want a file sync service where a user can upload a file to the cloud and have it synced across all of the user's devices.
A file in the service can be at most 4GB big.
The upload and downloads in the service should be efficient and resumable.
The user's bandwidth is critical, so the service should be efficient with bandwidth.
I want the high-level components of the system to operate with high availability.
I want the system's data to be durable no matter what happens.
I want the system to define how it behaves while scaling up and scaling down.
I want the system to be cost-effective and to include a justification for the cost-effectiveness.
I want the design to describe how capacity planning helped make good design decisions.
I want the design to describe how other services will interact with the file sync service.
I want the system to ensure the data in the system is never in an inconsistent state.
I want the system to be free of deadlocks if applicable.
I want the design to ensure the throughput of the system is not affected by locking, and if it is affected, to state how it would affect throughput.
I want a design document that states critical design decisions, tradeoffs, components, services, and communications.
I want the design document to specify how the system handles at scale and what will eventually become a chokepoint.
I want the design to avoid unnecessary components and keep the system simple and elegant.
